videos.title: What If Gravity Was 10% Stronger?
videos.author: Kurzgesagt – In a Nutshell
videos.description:
Just 10% more gravity doesn’t sound too bad. Until satellites fall from the sky, bridges collapse, planes struggle to fly and earthquakes shake the planet. On the bright side: more diamonds!

videos.author: Kurzgesagt – In a Nutshell
videos.description:

videos.title: Why Ebola Keeps Coming Back
videos.author: Kurzgesagt – In a Nutshell
videos.description:
Ebola outbreaks can be contained, but ending them is another story. Conflict, fragile healthcare systems, and limited access to vaccines give the virus new chances to spread. Stopping one outbreak helps prevent the next.

videos.title: How Antidepressants Work
videos.author: Kurzgesagt – In a Nutshell
videos.description:
Antidepressants don't make people happy overnight. Instead, they slowly change how brain cells communicate, helping worn-down neural circuits recover over time. Here's why they take weeks to work, and why they help millions of people.
